description: ODC: the REFUSAL of the delete of a server ENTITY with consumers. WfCovProject is cited by the FK WfCovTask.ProjectId, which is bound to the identifier type (a child of the entity): the delete looks at the children's consumers and names the FK. Before, only the anonymous record `WfCovProject Record` refused the delete and hid the FK; it no longer counts as long as nobody uses it. The direct usages still shows no FK (use scope:subtree). Data batch, phase 3; tested coverage, phase 2.
